scenarios.environment: Windows x86_64 NTFS; synthetic file-backed failpoint
scenarios.setup: Inject before intent fsync/commit, close, cold reopen, retry
scenarios.expected: No success-visible intent after reopen; retry publishes once
scenarios.actual: Pre-state after reopen; one durable intent after retry

scenarios.setup: Terminate after durable intent before execution, cold reopen
scenarios.expected: Intent survives and is not succeeded
scenarios.actual: Intent survives restart; success is not inferred

scenarios.setup: Real tool effect followed by termination before outcome append
scenarios.command: External provider schedule required; no local command claimed
scenarios.actual: No dedicated external execution hook in current workspace

scenarios.environment: Windows x86_64 NTFS; synthetic WAL tail
scenarios.setup: Append outcome then truncate WAL tail; cold reopen
scenarios.expected: Complete prior records survive; damaged tail is not success
scenarios.actual: Prior records survive; tail is rejected

scenarios.setup: Terminate after durable outcome before publication/ref
scenarios.expected: Outbox remains recoverable and publication is idempotent
scenarios.actual: Republishable outbox retained; duplicate publication avoided

scenarios.environment: Windows x86_64 NTFS; synthetic SQLite commit
scenarios.setup: Inject before/after metadata commit and cold reopen
scenarios.expected: Readers see all pre-state or all post-state

scenarios.environment: Linux x86_64 Docker tmpfs; real ENOSPC plus synthetic short-write
scenarios.setup: Fill disposable 64 MiB tmpfs during CAS write
scenarios.expected: Partial CAS object unreachable; committed history readable

scenarios.environment: Windows x86_64 NTFS; synthetic directory-sync fault
scenarios.setup: Inject after CAS namespace publication before directory durability; cold reopen
scenarios.expected: Object is verified or publication fails closed; retry idempotent
scenarios.actual: Published object verifies after reopen; retry idempotent

scenarios.setup: Race writers with same expected head and retry
scenarios.expected: At most one CAS winner; retry returns committed result

scenarios.setup: Inject during projection apply/rebuild, cold reopen and rebuild
scenarios.expected: Projection state/cursor/ledger atomic; clean replay convergence
scenarios.actual: A-J schedule and repeated crashes converge; source events unchanged

scenarios.setup: Place registered secrets in metadata, events, CAS, logs and scan .pong
scenarios.expected: No raw secret bytes persisted or exported
scenarios.actual: Secret scan passes and unknown files fail closed

scenarios.environment: Windows x86_64 NTFS; generation migration process kill
scenarios.setup: Terminate before/after selector publication; cold reopen and retry
scenarios.expected: Old-only or fully verified new generation; no mixed visibility
scenarios.actual: Old-only/new-only visibility and retry idempotency hold

scenarios.environment: Windows x86_64 NTFS; real ACL revocation
scenarios.setup: Revoke read ACL, attempt access, restore ACL, cold reopen
scenarios.expected: PERMISSION_DENIED/quarantine or recovery_required; no unsafe publication
scenarios.actual: Kernel error 5 maps to PERMISSION_DENIED; recovery after ACL restore

scenarios.environment: Linux x86_64 Docker tmpfs; real ENOSPC
scenarios.setup: Exhaust disposable tmpfs during CAS, metadata and journal writes; cold reopen
scenarios.expected: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED; committed history and reopen remain valid
scenarios.actual: CAS/metadata/journal runs return RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED and preserve history
